title: WROXIM: A Network-Level Simulation Platform for Wavelength-Routed Optical Networks-on-Chip
problem: Wavelength-routed optical NoCs (WRONoCs) lack network-level simulation tools for evaluating end-to-end communication despite having device/circuit-level simulators.
motivation: Network-level WRONoC simulation enables system-level design exploration and optimization for practical deployment.
method: WROXIM extends the open-source Noxim simulator by adding cycle-accurate modeling of optical components—waveguides (light transmission channels), serializers and deserializers (electrical-to-optical signal converters), and buffers (data storage). This allows the simulator to handle both optical and electrical parts of the network, enabling end-to-end communication simulation at clock-cycle precision.
key_novelty: WROXIM simulates wavelength-routed optical networks at network level by combining optical and electrical component models with realistic task workloads.
contributions: Network-level simulation platform for WRONoCs adapted from Noxim
Cycle-accurate optical component modeling (waveguides, buffers, PEs)
Full electrical-optical integration for end-to-end data movement
Task-driven workload support with latency, throughput, energy metrics
limitations: Simulation platform only; no real silicon results; photonic component model fidelity not validated against silicon.
